tiers.name: BARNACLE
tiers.tag: Stuck to the hull and paying.

fever.name: Deep Pressure
fever.text: Bet more, dive deeper. Each spin costs 2x your bet, and the Deep Dive becomes about 3.3 times as likely.
fever.onMsg: DEEP PRESSURE ON. TOTAL BET x2

buys.name: Dive Ticket
buys.text: Skip the sifting. Go straight to the Deep Dive with 8 free dives. Jellies drift left and grow.
buys.confirmText: DIVE TICKET: 3 Sonar Buoys ping and the Deep Dive starts right away with 8 free dives.

buys.name: Abyss Pass
buys.text: The premium ticket. 12 dives, the Tide already at +2, a Jelly on every dive and more Jellies in the herd.
buys.confirmText: ABYSS PASS: 12 dives, Tide starts at +2, a guaranteed Jelly every dive. Only for the brave (and the broke).

intro.quote: "Fine. Hold your breath. Don't touch the Jellies."

outro.label: YOU SALVAGED
outro.quote: "Hmph. Not bad. Don't get used to it."

luck.name: MAX LUCK
luck.text: Pay 392x per spin and keep it on. Every spin has a 5% chance of landing 3 golden MAX coins and winning 7,500x your bet. Leave it on for as many spins as you like.
luck.onMsg: MAX LUCK ON. TOTAL BET x392

features.title: DRIFTING JELLY
features.text: Lantern Jellies are wild, grow every drift and float left. Their values add in a reel, and the reels multiply.

features.title: DEEP DIVE
features.text: Land 3 Sonar Buoys for 8 free dives. The Tide rises, the Jellies grow, and a Jelly is guaranteed every third dive.
